description: Installation of 1No. BT Street Hub Unit and associated advertisement panels on either side of the unit
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5c05e417-7fff-4cc6-2410-abd372490c48"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed StreetHub </span><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">fails to contribute to a safe road environment where traffic accident casualties are steadily reduced in support of Vision Zero objectives. The introduction of <span id="docs-internal-guid-341440ac-7fff-2d5a-e57c-26650da4d272"><span style="font-size: 10pt; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">a large digital advertisement in proximity to a 30 MPH road introduces unnecessary distraction and physical obstruction, contrary to highway safety. Furthermore, </span></span>reducing the width of the footpath in an area that already contains street furniture, including a bike rack, bike storage, and parking metres, reduces the amount of pavement available for the free-flow of pedestrians without obstruction, harmful to the</span></span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; white-space-collapse: preserve;"> quality and safety of the walking environment. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies </span><span id="docs-internal-guid-92bacf55-7fff-de20-c611-931c695da809"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">D8 (Public realm) and </span></span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; white-space-collapse: preserve;">T2 (Healthy streets) of the London Plan (2021) and policies </span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; white-space-collapse: preserve;">PP1 (Public Realm), LP7 (Advertisements), LP41</span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; white-space-collapse: preserve;"> (Liveable Neighbourhoods), and LP42 (Walking and Cycling) of Hackney’s Local Development Plan (2020).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d81b6ae0-7fff-aff2-01f6-fbb79cfb3d9c"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of its siting, would result in an increase in anti-social behaviour and crime in an area that already contains high levels of anti-social behaviour and crime. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies D3 (</span><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach); GG1 (Building strong and inclusive communities); </span><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">D4 (Delivering good design), and D8 (Public realm) of the London Plan (2021) and policies PP1 (Public Realm) and LP1 (High Quality Design) of Hackney's Local Development Plan (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b9019e05-7fff-1cdc-d4ac-62b6c5196435"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of its size, scale, detailed design and appearance, and illumination, featuring a moving digital display, would result in an obtrusive and visually incongruous feature that contributes to an unsightly proliferation and clutter of signage and street furniture in the local area that would detract from the design, character, and appearance of the wider area. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies D3 (</span><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), </span><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">D4 (Delivering good design), and D8 (Public realm) of the London Plan (2021) and policies PP1 (Public Realm) and LP1 (High Quality Design), LP7 (Advertisements) of Hackney's Local Development Plan LP33 (2020).</span></span></p>
